text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. MOD Developments (Charles) Limited Partnership is constructing a 48-storey residential building at 55-61 Charles Street East. The site is located on the south-west corner of Charles Street East and Macy DuBois Lane (east intersection). Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the south sidewalk and a 2.7 metre-wide portion of the westbound south-side curb lane on Charles Street East, between Macy DuBois Lane (east intersection) and a point 45.8 metres west for a period of 33 months (i.e. October 1, 2021 to June 30, 2024) to accommodate a construction staging area.
